title: locli.json
description: Configuration for @locli/cli: which locli project an app uses and where its text files live.

apiURL.description: locli server. Overridden by --api-url, LOCLI_API_URL or LOCALIZE_API_URL.

name.description: Project name (used when init creates the project).

sourceLanguage.description: Source language code, e.g. en or de. Must match the project and String Catalogs.

path.description: Relative to locli.json. xcstrings: the catalog file. android-xml: the res directory. json: a file pattern with {locale}, e.g. messages/{locale}.json.

file.description: android-xml: resource file name inside values*/ (default strings.xml).

keyPrefix.description: json: prefix added to keys in locli (e.g. an i18next namespace) and stripped on pull.
